title: Find Center of Star Graph
summary: Given an undirected star graph with n nodes numbered 1 to n, where one node is the center and is connected to all other nodes by exactly n - 1 edges, identify the center node from a 2D integer array of edges.
statement: Given an undirected star graph with n nodes numbered 1 to n, where one node is the center and is connected to all other nodes by exactly n - 1 edges, identify the center node from a 2D integer array of edges.
constraints: The input is a valid undirected star with at least three nodes.
Return the one node incident to every edge.
hints: The center must occur in each edge.
Only the first two edges are needed because their common endpoint is the center.
Check which endpoint of the first edge appears in the second.
In a valid star, two distinct edges share only the center, so this intersection identifies it uniquely.
editorial: In a valid star, two distinct edges share only the center, so this intersection identifies it uniquely.

tests.explanation: Node two occurs in all three edges.
Node one is the shared endpoint of every edge.
